Not ready for review, pushed for experimenting.

This PR contains an embedding subcompositor implementation that allows mixing and matching avalonia and other toolkit's content without airspace issues. This works by running an in-process wayland compositor and short-circuiting the embedded toolkit via WAYLAND_SOCKET var. Subscompositor shows windows as toplevel avalonia windows if you do nothing with them or hosts them as controls if special APIs are called on xdg_toplevel instances.

The PR contains an example of GTK wiring. GTK wiring will NOT be shipped as nuget, since:
1) it needs a rather ugly hack for perfect resize handling (I had to intercept calls in GTK's frame clock and rely on heuristic to make calls, I've confirmed this to be safe for current and all previous GTK3 versions, but it's technically messing with undocumented internals)
